title: std::poisson_distribution<IntType>::mean
summary: Returns the μ parameter the distribution was constructed with. The parameter defines mean number of occurrences of the event.
html:
double mean() const;
 (since C++11)

Returns the μ parameter the distribution was constructed with. The parameter defines mean number of occurrences of the event. The default value is 1.0.

Parameters

(none)

Return value

Floating point value identifying the μ distribution parameter.

See also

(C++11)
 gets or sets the distribution parameter object
